0022600136.text: The Toronto Raptors (2-1, 1-0 at home) are second in the Atlantic and fourth in the East, and they lost their most recent game. The Orlando Magic (1-2, 0-2 at home) are 10th in the East and have won their last game. Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram (out, Achilles surgery) and Nate Bittle (out, foot fracture), while Kawhi Leonard is day-to-day with knee inflammation and is a game-time decision. Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (out, ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (out, knee), Jonathan Isaac (out, knee), Noah Penda (out, hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (out, ankle sprain). The teams have no games yet in the 2026-27 season series, but the Raptors won the 2025-26 series 2-1, and their most recent meeting was a 139-87 Toronto win on March 29, 2026.
